# Release Module

## Summary
Appends a release event to the cohort (module, when, by whom).

## Refuses when
cohort not running; module not in the course; already released.

## Non-goals
Business rules beyond those listed belong to the consumer.

## Example
The linked cohort shows its release events on its timeline.
attributes.cardDescription: Releases a course module to a running cohort, recording when and by whom.
